Secret J · Terms & Conditions · Account

Privacy Policy

Version 2026-11-14 · Effective 14 November 2026

This policy describes how Secret J processes account and career information. You can search public jobs without creating an account.

1. Information you provide

When you create an account, we receive your email address, name and a password that is stored as a one-way hash. Optional features can store your CV (PDF or DOCX), profile information, photo, job preferences, saved jobs, application tracking entries, and email alert settings. We also keep your recorded acceptance of the terms and privacy notice.

2. Technical information

Sessions use cookies for authentication. Security measures may record authentication-attempt metadata, session identifiers, timestamps and diagnostic information. A first-visit introduction uses local browser storage to remember that you have viewed or skipped it; it is not linked to your account.

3. How we use data

We process your data to create and secure your account, store and display your CV/profile, optionally extract fields from your CV, personalize search results and alerts, save opportunities, and operate and troubleshoot the service. Email alerts are optional. Your CV is not automatically submitted to employers by this service.

4. Storage and processors

Account and profile information is processed using third-party infrastructure providers for hosting, data storage and, where enabled, email delivery. Information may be processed in hosting regions outside your country. Public job listings may be published separately, but private account information and uploaded CV files are not intended for public publication.

5. Sharing

We do not publish your private CV or profile in the public job feed. We may share the minimum data necessary with service providers processing data on our behalf, where legally required, or to prevent abuse. External employer application sites receive information only when you choose to interact with them.

6. Retention and deletion

Account data is kept while your account is active or as reasonably necessary for service, security and legal obligations. You can delete an uploaded CV from the CV & photo page. To request access, correction or deletion of your account information, contact us. Security logs or backups may persist for a limited period according to provider configuration and applicable requirements; deletion may not be instantaneous in backups.

7. Security and choices

Private account endpoints require authentication; passwords are hashed and sessions use protected cookies. You can update your profile and turn off optional email alerts. No storage service is completely risk-free. Avoid including unnecessary sensitive personal information in your CV.

8. Children's information

Secret J is intended for job seekers able to lawfully use this service. If you believe a child's personal data was uploaded without appropriate authority, contact us.

9. Changes and contact

We may update this notice and display the current version here. Contact privacy@jobsnow.tech for privacy questions and rights requests. The mailbox must be active before public registration is enabled.

This notice should be verified against actual hosting, processor contracts and applicable privacy law before public launch.
